# Feature: V6 Material Kombination Catalog

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Material → Formeln → Kombination shows the locked V6 Slice-1 FormulaRecipe catalog (~105) as Formula cards with `Rolle: Kombination`, not only user-saved Combinate recipes from localStorage.

## Preconditions

- App open on Material (Card Forge library)
- V6 generated recipes present: `src/generated/v6/formulaRecipes.generated.ts` (`recipeCount: 105`)
- Optional: empty VFX registry (no Combinate saves)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Material → Formeln → filter **Kombination** lists ~105 V6 catalog entries (plus any non-duplicate Combinate saves)
- [ ] Each catalog card has `type: Formula`, effect `Rolle: Kombination`, `Quelle: V6 Katalog`
- [ ] Stable ids match generated `recipeId` (e.g. `v6-te-impulsgeschoss-feuer`)
- [ ] Art uses component T/E/K PNG paths (no per-combo hero required)
- [ ] Empty state „Noch keine Kombinationen“ does **not** appear when catalog is present

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Combinate save with same T+E+K as a catalog recipe is not duplicated (catalog kept; Combinate skip)
- [ ] Distinct Combinate saves still appear alongside catalog (`Quelle: Combinate`)
- [ ] Catalog Kombinationen do not offer broken Combinate „aktivieren“ (registry-only)

## Regression

- [ ] Formeln Bausteine (Technik/Essenz/Katalysator) still list as before
- [ ] Combinate save → Material still works for unique recipes
- [ ] `npm run checks` green

## Assumptions

- Dedup key = techniqueId + essenceId + catalystId (null-normalized), not display name
- German UI labels: `Quelle: V6 Katalog`; empty-state copy may mention Katalog briefly if ever empty

## Implementation Notes

- Mapper: `src/features/forge/data/v6FormulaRecipesToForge.ts` → `packToForgeCards`
- Dedup: Combinate saves with same T|E|K as a V6 catalog recipe are skipped; catalog kept
- Art: `component_images` = resolved `/cards/formula/<slug>.png` for each slot; `LetzFetzCard` shows strip when ≥2
- `resolveFormulaCardArtPath` accepts `v5-` and `v6-` component ids
- Catalog detail panel explains V6 Katalog (no Combinate activate)
- Formula category `expectedCount`: 130 (25 Bausteine + 105 Katalog)
- Unit tests: `v6FormulaRecipesToForge.test.ts`, extended `packToForge.test.ts`, `manifest.test.ts`
